text: At its meeting held December 16 and 17, 2021, City Council appointed the following members to the Toronto Investment Board for a term of office from December 18, 2021 to December 16, 2025, and until successors are appointed: John Crocker, as Chair Kevin Adolphe Sue Lemon These new appointments fill the positions previously held by Matthew Flynn and Sharon Ranson whose terms of office came to an end December 17, 2021.
The Toronto Investment Board received the item for information.
